mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYMMDD')||ECC_SEQ_MAIL_SEND_RECORD_ID.NEXTVAL AS msrId FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_ECC_MAIL_SEND_RECORD ( MSR_ID, CONF_ID, MS_FROM, MS_TO, MS_CC, MS_HEAD, MS_BODY, MS_ATTACHS, SERVER_IP, SERVER_NAME, MS_TIME, CREATE_DATE, MS_SCC ) VALUES ( #{msrId}, #{confId}, #{from}, #{to}, #{cc}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{attachs}, #{serverIp}, #{serverName}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), SYSDATE, #{scc} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_ECC_MAIL_SEND_RECORD SET MS_RESULT=#{result} WHERE MSR_ID=#{id}
UPDATE T_ECC_MAIL_CONFIG T SET T.TEMPLATE_HEAD =#{head}, T.TEMPLATE_BODY =#{body}, T.MODIFI_DATE =SYSDATE, T.REMARK =#{remark} WHERE T.MC_ID =#{mcId}

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO T_ECC_MAIL_APPEND ( APPEND_ID, SOURCE_ID, APPEND_CATEGORY, CONFIG_ID ) VALUES( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYMMDD')||ECC_SEQ_MAIL_APPEND_ID.NEXTVAL, #{item.sourceId}, #{item.category}, #{item.configId} )

mapper.select:
SELECT T.MC_ID, T.CONFIG_CATEGORY, T.TEMPLATE_HEAD, T.TEMPLATE_BODY, T.REMARK, T.RUN_STATUS, ECC_IBF_GET_DCTNAME_EX('MAIL_RUN_STATUS',T.RUN_STATUS) AS RUN_STATUS_NAME, TO_CHAR(T.MODIFI_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') MODIFI_DATE, (SELECT MS_RESULT FROM (SELECT TR.MS_RESULT,TR.CONF_ID FROM T_ECC_MAIL_SEND_RECORD TR ORDER BY TR.CREATE_DATE DESC ) TEMP WHERE ROWNUM = 1 AND TEMP.CONF_ID = T.MC_ID ) RESULT FROM T_ECC_MAIL_CONFIG T WHERE 1 = 1
AND T.CONFIG_CATEGORY LIKE '%'||#{sp.title}||'%'

SELECT T.MC_ID, T.CONFIG_CATEGORY, T.TEMPLATE_HEAD, T.TEMPLATE_BODY, T.RUN_STATUS, ECC_IBF_GET_DCTNAME_EX('MAIL_RUN_STATUS',T.RUN_STATUS) AS RUN_STATUS_NAME, (TO_CHAR(T.CREATE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) CREATE_DATE, (TO_CHAR(T.MODIFI_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) MODIFI_DATE, T.REMARK FROM T_ECC_MAIL_CONFIG T WHERE T.MC_ID =#{configId}

SELECT T.APPEND_ID, T.SOURCE_ID, T.APPEND_CATEGORY, T.CONFIG_ID, (SELECT U.EMPID FROM T_ECC_EMPLOYEE U WHERE U.EMPID=T.SOURCE_ID) VAL, (SELECT U.EMNAME FROM T_ECC_EMPLOYEE U WHERE U.EMPID=T.SOURCE_ID) VAL_NM, (SELECT TE.EMPEMAIL FROM T_ECC_EMPLOYEEE TE WHERE TE.EMPID = T.SOURCE_ID) MAIL_PATH FROM T_ECC_MAIL_APPEND T WHERE T.CONFIG_ID=#{configId} AND T.APPEND_CATEGORY=#{category}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_ECC_MAIL_CONFIG SET RUN_STATUS = #{runStatus}, MODIFI_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MC_ID = #{mcId}
mapper.select: SELECT T.MAIL_TO as mailTo, T.MAIL_CC as mailCc, T.MAIL_SCC as mailScc FROM T_MAIL_CONF_MAILPATH T WHERE T.CONF_ID = #{confId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MAIL_CONF_MAILPATH( MAIL_ID, CONF_ID, MAIL_CC, MAIL_SCC, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE ) VALUES( (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')|| LPAD(ECC_SEQ_CONF_MAILPATH_ID.NEXTVAL, 6,'0')), #{confId}, #{mailCc}, #{mailScc}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MAIL_CONF_MAILPATH SET MAIL_CC=#{mailCc}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CONF_ID=#{confId}
